en.name: Absolute: Black Blood Circle
en.description: Instill your battle axe with forces of the earth to create a circle around you. Those who enter your attack range shall pay the price for their actions.
en.command: {KeyBind:Dash} + {KeyBind:CrouchOrSkill} {KeyBind:Attack1} to attack instantly Can be added to a Quick Slot
tooltip: All Evasion -12 for 10 sec on hits
Pull in the target on hits
Charging consumes Stamina. Auto-attacks after a certain period of time.
71.78% damage in PvP only
